note: Lines Margo says when something a choice left behind is still true (F.5, D-231): each reads a flag an event sets, in conditions.when. They count toward coverage, inside the 500-line cap.

items.text: I have the manifest number from that dead hull filed where I can see it. I did not ask to be able to see it.
The new scrubbers are holding. I would like it noted that they were the last new scrubbers.
The boy from the hold has cleaned the air plant twice. Nobody asked him. I have added him to the crew list in pencil.
The brig has been occupied for some hours. I keep the lights on in there. It seems the least I can do.
Something aboard is eating our rations that is not on my crew list. I would like it on my crew list, or off my ship.
One of the manifest crates has a new seal on it. A good one. Better than the company's, which is the problem.
The two who were fighting have been sitting at the same end of the mess table. I am not going to say anything in case it stops.
The load in the hold is held up by two crates of rations. I mention it because sooner or later someone will be hungry.
One of ours has stopped looking at the scope. I have stopped mentioning what is on it when they are in the room.
Somebody was told to keep it down, and has. They have also stopped saying good morning to me. I am told that is not my business.
